title: Is There No God in Israel

request.style: English, male solo voice, warm and narrative, acoustic guitar, cello, fiddle, light percussion, somber and tense mood, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Ahab is gone and Moab rebels against the throne
Ahaziah falls through the lattice in his upper room
Injured and ill he sends word out to the coast
Go ask Baal-Zebub the god of Ekron about the hope

[Chorus]
Is there no God in Israel that you must go ask
The god of Ekron for a sign and a task
You will not get up from the bed you are lying on
You will surely die as the Lord has spoken

[Verse]
The angel of the Lord speaks to Elijah the Tishbite
Go meet the messengers of the king of Samaria
Ask them why they seek a foreign idol's word
When the Lord of Hosts is right here in the land

[Chorus]
Is there no God in Israel that you must go ask
The god of Ekron for a sign and a task
You will not get up from the bed you are lying on
You will surely die as the Lord has spoken

[Verse]
The first captain goes up the mountain with fifty men
Fire comes down from heaven and consumes them all
The second captain falls to his knees before the prophet
Pleading for his life and the lives of his men

[Bridge]
Elijah goes down with the third to the king's bedside
Saying because you sought a god in Ekron's land
You will not rise from the bed you lie upon
The word of the Lord is confirmed in the dust

[Chorus]
Is there no God in Israel that you must go ask
The god of Ekron for a sign and a task
You will not get up from the bed you are lying on
You will surely die as the Lord has spoken

[Outro]
Every kingdom divided against itself falls
Satan cannot drive out Satan
He is divided against himself
